create_lamb_optimizer: create a FairseqLAMB optimizer instance with apex FusedLAMB for model training
configure_lamb_betas: configure the LAMB optimizer betas using the --lamb-betas argument
set_lamb_epsilon: set the LAMB optimizer epsilon value using the --lamb-eps argument
set_weight_decay: set the LAMB optimizer weight decay using the --weight-decay or --wd argument
review_optimizer_config: review the FairseqLAMB optimizer_config property that returns lr, betas, eps, and weight_decay kwargs
